Adults with type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular risk factors may not be the right population to detect skeletal benefits of glycemic control — baseline fracture risk, bone quality, and confounding medications (e.g., thiazolidinediones known to increase fracture risk) may have obscured any potential benefit.
